name: NG exhaustion chain phase-1 mechanism interpretation addendum
reason: Clarify that replicated higher-order dependence is itself a chain mechanism and must not be discarded merely because the original first-order event stops adding unique information at later links.

order_depth.question: How many prior sequential aftermaths add reproducible out-of-sample predictive information beyond shorter history?
order_depth.interpretation: Any replicated D>=2 incremental depth is a higher-order chain finding, regardless of whether the oldest origin remains uniquely informative.

origin_persistence.question: Do the same individual origins that carry one predictive link disproportionately carry the next link as well?
origin_persistence.interpretation: Positive cross-depth origin association identifies inherited-origin propagation. Lack of positive origin association does NOT negate higher-order chain structure; it identifies a rolling/re-origin mechanism instead.

mechanism_reporting.single_step_only: No replicated incremental depth beyond D=1.
mechanism_reporting.rolling_higher_order: Replicated aggregate D>=2 depth exists, but the original event does not show positive cross-depth enrichment. Each newer event may become the dominant local origin while higher-order sequential structure remains.
mechanism_reporting.inherited_origin_higher_order: Replicated aggregate D>=2 depth exists and the same origins are positively enriched across successive depths.
mechanism_reporting.mixed_or_conditional: Evidence differs by depth/model/week; preserve as candidate structure for Phase 2 characterization rather than collapsing it into no-chain.

phase2_implication: After Phase 1 freezes both order depth and origin-persistence behavior, characterize each discovered mechanism and instance using exhaustion geometry, polarity, family, microstructure, tape outcomes, duration, timing/session context, and other legal characteristics. Those characteristics may explain why some sequences roll/re-origin and others preserve one origin, but cannot retroactively create the Phase-1 chain evidence.
